purpose: Production-support assets for robust arbitrary-action pose extraction and optional frame interpolation after the core SSD generation stack is installed.
notes: DWPose is the preferred whole-body pose extractor for driving-video/action preparation.

The legacy CMU OpenPose body/hand/face weight set is intentionally not downloaded because the bundled OpenPose preprocessor is explicitly non-commercial-only and DWPose supersedes it for this project.
FILM is downloaded so interpolation is available when useful, but it is not the default for final sprite timing because generated in-betweens can soften or distort pixel-art silhouettes.
MediaPipe face/pose task assets required by the repo are already committed inside the upstream clone and are verified by runner 27 rather than downloaded again.
wav2vec2 and AniPortrait audio models remain excluded because audio-driven portrait animation is unrelated to character spritesheet authoring.
